How it works

Three gestures, zero training.

1

The housekeeper taps the room

One tap when she starts (yellow), one when she is done (green). It even works where there is no signal.

2

The front desk sees everything live

The board updates by itself and chimes when a room is ready or an issue comes in.

3

A problem? Just a photo

The red button opens the camera: the report reaches the front desk instantly, ready to forward on WhatsApp.

Easy for everyone, from day one

Designed for people who don't like apps: big buttons, clear colours, very few words.

  • No passwordsEach housekeeper has her own QR code: she scans it and her page opens.
  • Works without Wi-FiIn corridors with no signal, taps are kept on the phone and sent automatically when the connection returns.
  • Big buttons, even with glovesHuge numbers and colours: grey to do, yellow cleaning, green ready.
  • In her own languageThe front desk chooses the language for each housekeeper.
  • Installs like an appAn icon on the Home screen, no app store needed.
  • The coming days at a glanceThe calendar shows the rooms planned for the week.

Frequently asked questions

Do we need to install an app?+

No: it is a web app. It opens from the QR code and, if you like, can be added to the Home screen like a normal app.

Do housekeepers need an account?+

No email, no password: each one has her personal QR code. If a phone is lost, the front desk simply generates a new code.

What if there is no signal in the corridor?+

The app keeps working: taps are stored on the phone and sent as soon as the connection returns. Nothing gets lost.

Does it work with our PMS?+

It imports bookings from a CSV file, which almost every hotel software can export. Check-outs and stay-overs are created automatically.

Do we need company phones?+

No. The housekeeper's own phone works, Android or iPhone, or a tablet on each floor.

Are the photos of the reports safe?+

Only hotel staff can see them and they are deleted automatically after 90 days. Links forwarded on WhatsApp expire after 30 days.

How does the free trial work?+

Write to us, we activate your hotel and help you get started. For 3 months you pay nothing and need no credit card. At the end we send you the details for the yearly payment: you decide whether to continue.
